limitations_and_next_slice: The private review endpoint is not yet wired into a GPT Action or MCP tool.
No document upload, OCR, or document-derived verification exists.
No public aggregate dashboard or causal/statistical analysis exists.
External deployment still needs exact privacy-notice, GPT/provider disclosure, retention/backup, encryption-key, routing, and rollback evidence.
The recommended next slice is the smallest authenticated GPT review tool over this existing projection, without adding institutional workflow.
